kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-tags --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1130916744880000 --role-type 1 --target-uuid a1b2c3-0000 --target-type AliUId --target-relation incident_uuid_:_3fce2d3b65fc2bd05cac6d000000 --next-token AAAAASLVeIxed4466E0LVmGkzwS6hJKd9DGVGMDRM6Lu0000 --max-results 50 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTags

parameters.help_en:
The region where the threat analysis data management center is located. Specify the management center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: the asset is in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: the asset is outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user ID that the administrator switches to when viewing as another member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The view type. Valid values:
0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。取值：
0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The UUID of the target asset
parameters.name: target_uuid

parameters.help_en:
The scan object type. Valid values:

1: snapshot 
2: image
parameters.help_zh:
扫描对象类型。取值：

1：快照 
2：镜像
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next query. Leave this parameter empty for the first query or if no more results exist. If a next query is available, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return when using NextToken-based pagination. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 使用NextToken方式查询时，每次最多返回的结果数。取值范围：1~100。默认值：50
parameters.name: max_results

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of results to return when using NextToken-based pagination. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 50
MaxResults.description_zh: 使用NextToken方式查询时，每次最多返回的结果数。取值范围：1~100。默认值：50

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next query. Leave this parameter empty for the first query or if no more results exist. If a next query is available, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
NextToken.description_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值

Tags.description_en:
The entity tags. The value is a JSON array string in the following format:

`"[{"tagKey1":"tagValue1"},{"tagKey2":"tagValue2"}]"`
Tags.description_zh:
实体标签。格式为JSON数组字符串：

`"[{"tagKey1":"tagValue1"},{"tagKey2":"tagValue2"}]"`

items.description_en:
The entity tags. The value is a JSON array string in the following format:

`"[{"tagKey1":"tagValue1"},{"tagKey2":"tagValue2"}]"`
items.description_zh:
实体标签。格式为JSON数组字符串：

`"[{"tagKey1":"tagValue1"},{"tagKey2":"tagValue2"}]"`

Count.description_en: The number of quick queries returned on the current page
Count.description_zh: 当前页返回的快速查询个数

Tag.description_en: The key of the tag to query. You can specify multiple keys. N is a positive integer
Tag.description_zh: 要查询的标签的key，可有多个。N为正整数
